== Title ==
<span lang="ja">タトゥイーン：ラーズ家のモイスチャー・ファーム</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
'''Light''' — <span lang="ja">ベルー ラーズ、ルークを配備する場合 配備コストを－１。</span>

'''Dark''' — <span lang="ja">武器運命数を引く際、それぞれに＋１。</span>

== Lore ==
The card has no printed lore box.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm]].

'''Lore''' — The card has no printed lore box.

'''Game text''' — Light Side. When deploying Beru Lars or Luke, deploy cost is -1. Dark Side. When drawing weapon destiny, add 1 to each.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Light subtracts 1 from deploy cost when deploying Beru Lars or Luke, and omits here. Dark omits your and here.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-L-tatooinelarsmoisturefarm.gif|Original English face]], [[Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm]].</ref>
